title: Fallback Reservoir Prioritization Catalog — regional model availability telemetry
creator: Marisol Nguyen
description: Create a prioritized catalog (a lightweight decision table) of fallback 'reservoirs' (model variants, quant+kernel profiles, regional pools, and partner endpoints) by region and customer tier. The catalog will combine competitive availability telemetry, internal capacity signals, and cost/latency heuristics so product and SRE teams can automate routing policies and procurement triggers when primary model endpoints degrade or become unavailable.
goals: Define a reproducible scoring formula for fallback suitability (latency, cost delta, quality gap, availability volatility)
Surface top-3 fallback reservoirs per region and per common workload archetype (short-gen, chat, embeddings)
Produce a machine-readable catalog that can be consumed by routing rules and runbook playbooks
acceptance_criteria: Scoring formula documented and validated against 3 historical outage scenarios
Catalog contains entries for NA, EU, APAC with at least 8 candidate reservoirs per region
Automated test harness can ingest the catalog and simulate a routing fallback decision in the staging runtime
PM/SRE sign-off and a short demo in next product sync
tasks: Gather telemetry: 90-day availability/per-region signals from provider watchtower and internal hosted-API logs
Map model variants to compute affinity and quant profiles (link GPU affinity matrix)
Define scoring weights for latency/cost/quality/availability with initial default values
Prototype catalog schema (CSV + JSON export) and store in /drive/ModelFallbacks/
Run simulated outage experiments (3 scenarios) and record decision alignment with manual operator choices
Document runbook changes and generate a README for routing-engine integration
research_findings: Preliminary signal pull (2025-01 logs) shows APAC has higher volatility for larger context models resulting in 2–3x fallback frequency
Open-model variants with aggressive quantization reduce cost by 40% but may increase hallucination risk for retrieval-heavy prompts
Dedicated pools in EU-west have predictable throughput but limited compatibility with some quant+kernel combos; requires procurement windows
key_decisions: Initial scoring will weight latency 35%, availability volatility 30%, cost delta 20%, quality gap 15% — to be revisited after experiments

Catalog schema will include human-readable notes and machine fields: reservoir_id, region, model_variant, quant_profile, expected_cost_multiplier, median_p95_latency_ms, last_seen_availability, provenance_link
Start with three workload archetypes for prioritization: short-gen (<=256 tokens), chat (streaming + memory), embeddings (batch/real-time)
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Quality regressions when switching to quantized reservoirs — Mitigation: only use quantized reservoirs as 2nd/3rd fallback and attach quick-eval prompts
Risk: Catalog drift as providers update models — Mitigation: schedule weekly reconciliation job and add change webhook triggers
Risk: Procurement lead time for Dedicated capacity in some regions — Mitigation: mark reservoirs with procurement windows and add replacement suggestions
